{{Top|leg}}
Modular plating was designed as a light-weight substitute for more cumbersome [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. '''Modular plating Mark III''' was manufactured using exotic materials and highly-detailed techniques to produce the best light-weight, high-impact [[droid armor]] .

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
